title: decree router reply
description: reply.json: a router's answer to request.json, written to DECREE_REPLY in the router's run folder. This is the general shape of every reply; the `reply_schema` in each request is the exact schema for that request, with `event` limited to its options and `probabilities` to their names. decree reads `null` as an absent key and ignores keys it does not know, but a router should write neither. Reference: docs/reference/runs.md, Model.

event.description: The pick: one of the request's options, exactly. Anything else makes the decision `error`; decree never fuzzy-matches an option.

confidence.description: The router's confidence in the pick, 0 to 1. With `min_confidence` set, a missing or lower confidence produces `unsure`.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence; recorded on the `decision` event.

probabilities.description: A number per option, recorded on the `decision` event.

examples.reason: One test fails on an off-by-one in the window check; the fix is local.
